name: Oikko – All-in-One Team Management
author: WP Plugin Studio

sections.description:
Oikko – All-in-One Team Management allows you to streamline your office operations with a modular, easy-to-use system. The free version includes:

  • Chat Module: User-to-user chat
  • Time Clock Module: Clock-in/out and user reports
  • Profile Module: Update personal profile information
  • Documents Module: Upload and manage your own documents
  • User Management Module: Add/edit users, assign roles and designations
  • Time Converter Module: Convert time zones easily
  • Departments Module: Create/edit departments, assign users
  • Designations Module: Manage designations, assign users
  • Shifts Module: Create/edit shifts, assign users

Shortcodes

  • [oikkotm_dashboard] – Display the Plugin Frontend Dashboard.

Privacy

This plugin can optionally connect to the OpenStreetMap Nominatim API
(https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org) to convert coordinates into location
names. This feature is disabled by default and can be turned on or off anytime
from the plugin settings. No personal or identifiable data is transmitted.

Additional Notes

  • Compatible with WordPress 6.2+
  • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly
  • No caching implemented in initial release (performance improvements will follow in future updates)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the oikko-team-management folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Setup Oikko Team Management from the WordPress dashboard.
sections.faq:
Can I track multiple users?

Yes, clock-in/out and reporting works for all users in the free version.

Does it include chat?

Yes, users can chat one-to-one.

Is it compatible with WordPress 6.2+?

Yes, fully tested with WordPress 6.2 up to 6.9.

  • Initial release with all free features: chat, time tracking, HR, shifts, documents.
